theme: 教材字彙・中高階 750–850 第 61 群

items.pos: n. 一雙；一對 | v. 配對
items.colloc: a pair of 一雙 | match and pair 配對組合
items.distinct: couple 兩個人或事 | twins 雙胞胎
ex: Please pair the socks before folding them.
摺疊襪子前請先將它們配對。
We bought a pair of high-quality leather shoes.
我們買了一雙高品質的皮鞋。
The company will pair each intern with a mentor.
公司將為每位實習生安排一位導師。

items.colloc: pour coffee 倒咖啡 | pour money into 投入大量資金
items.distinct: spill 潑灑；溢出 | splash 濺起
ex: Could you pour some water into my glass?
可以幫我往杯子裡倒點水嗎？
Investors continue to pour capital into the startup.
投資者持續將資金投入這家新創公司。
Heavy rain began to pour during the outdoor event.
戶外活動期間下起了傾盆大雨。

items.colloc: accuse someone of sth. 指控某人某事 | falsely accuse 錯誤指控
items.distinct: blame 責怪 | charge 控告（法律用語）
ex: The manager was accused of ignoring safety regulations.
該經理被指控忽視安全規定。
They accused him of stealing sensitive company data.
他們指控他竊取公司機密數據。
Do not accuse anyone without having solid evidence.
在沒有確鑿證據前，不要指控任何人。

items.pos: n. 角度；觀點 | v. 調整角度
items.colloc: from a different angle 從不同角度 | camera angle 攝影角度
items.distinct: aspect 方面 | viewpoint 觀點
ex: We need to look at this problem from a new angle.
我們需要從新的角度看待這個問題。
The camera angle shows the product features clearly.
攝影角度清晰地呈現了產品特色。
Marketing strategies should angle toward younger consumers.
行銷策略應針對年輕消費者調整方向。

items.pos: prep. 在…後面 | adv. 落後；在後
items.colloc: behind schedule 進度落後 | behind the scenes 在幕後
items.distinct: after 在之後（時間） | back 後方
ex: The construction project is running behind schedule.
這項建築工程的進度目前落後。
She works behind the scenes to support the team.
她在幕後工作以支援團隊。
There is a clear strategy behind this decision.
這項決策背後有著明確的策略。

items.pos: adj. 肯定會的；受束縛的 | v. 跳躍
items.colloc: bound to happen 必然發生 | be bound by rules 受規則束縛
items.distinct: limit 界限 | tie 綑綁
ex: Success is bound to follow such hard work.
如此努力工作肯定會帶來成功。
The contract is bound by international trade laws.
該合約受國際貿易法規約束。
We are bound for Tokyo for the annual conference.
我們準備前往東京參加年度會議。

items.colloc: confine to 限制在 | confine within 侷限於
items.distinct: limit 額度限制 | restrict 約束
ex: Please confine your report to the main topic.
請將報告內容限制在主體議題上。
The discussion was confined to budget cuts only.
討論僅限於預算削減的部分。
Bad weather confined the staff to the office.
惡劣天氣使員工被迫留在辦公室內。

items.colloc: operate correctly 正確操作 | identify correctly 正確識別
items.distinct: accurately 精確地 | properly 適當地
ex: Ensure the machine is installed correctly before use.
使用前請確保機器安裝正確。
He correctly identified the cause of the system error.
他正確地指出了系統錯誤的原因。
Data must be entered correctly to ensure accuracy.
數據必須正確輸入以確保準確性。

items.pos: v. 計算；視為 | n. 總數
items.colloc: count on 依靠 | count as 算作
items.distinct: calculate 計算 | estimate 估計
ex: We need to count the inventory before we close.
打烊前我們需要清點庫存。
You can count on him for professional assistance.
你可以信賴他以獲得專業協助。
Every suggestion counts toward improving our workflow.
每一項建議對於改善工作流程都很重要。

items.colloc: beautiful countryside 美麗的鄉村 | live in the countryside 住鄉下
items.distinct: village 村莊 | rural area 農村地區
ex: Our company retreat will be held in the countryside.
公司員工旅遊將在鄉間舉行。
They prefer the peaceful life in the countryside.
他們偏好鄉間寧靜的生活。
Many tourists visit the countryside for fresh air.
許多遊客為了新鮮空氣而造訪鄉間。

items.colloc: pay off debt 償還債務 | in debt 負債
items.distinct: loan 貸款 | deficit 赤字
ex: The company is struggling to pay off its debt.
這家公司正努力償還債務。
He managed to clear all his personal debt.
他成功清償了所有個人債務。
High interest rates increased the total debt burden.
高利率增加了整體債務負擔。

items.pos: adj. 相等的；對等的 | n. 對應物
items.colloc: be equivalent to 相等於 | cash equivalent 現金等價物
items.distinct: equal 平等的；相等的 | identical 一模一樣的
ex: This certification is equivalent to a master's degree.
這張證書相當於碩士學位。
We need an equivalent level of professional experience.
我們需要具備同等專業經驗的人選。
The product price is equivalent to the market average.
該產品價格相當於市場平均值。

items.pos: v. 表達 | adj. 明確的；快遞的
items.colloc: express opinion 表達意見 | express delivery 快遞服務
items.distinct: state 陳述 | articulate 清楚表達
ex: Please express your feedback regarding the new policy.
請表達您對於新政策的意見回饋。
The board expressed concern about the declining profit.
董事會對於利潤下降表示擔憂。
I will send the documents by express mail today.
我今天會透過快遞郵寄這些文件。

items.colloc: expressly forbidden 明確禁止 | expressly stated 明確說明
items.distinct: clearly 清晰地 | specifically 特別地
ex: Smoking is expressly prohibited in the office area.
辦公區域明確禁止吸菸。
The contract expressly states the terms of payment.
合約中明確規定了付款條件。
He came here expressly to discuss the merger deal.
他來到這裡正是為了討論合併案。

items.colloc: yours faithfully 誠摯地（信件結尾） | follow faithfully 忠實遵循
items.distinct: loyally 忠誠地 | honestly 誠實地
ex: Our team has faithfully executed the project plan.
我們的團隊忠實地執行了專案計畫。
She faithfully attends every single staff meeting.
她忠實地參加每一場員工會議。
The film adaptation represents the book quite faithfully.
電影改編相當忠實地呈現了原著。

items.colloc: fishing industry 漁業 | go fishing 去釣魚
items.distinct: angling 垂釣 | trawling 拖網捕魚
ex: The local economy depends heavily on the fishing industry.
當地經濟相當依賴漁業。
Many employees went fishing during the weekend retreat.
許多員工在週末員工旅遊時去釣魚。
Strict regulations govern the fishing seasons here.
嚴格的規定管理著此地的捕魚季節。

items.colloc: fully understand 完全理解 | fully operational 完全運作
items.distinct: totally 完全地 | entirely 全部地
ex: We are fully aware of the potential risks involved.
我們充分了解涉及的潛在風險。
The new software system is now fully operational.
新軟體系統目前已完全投入運作。
Please ensure the report is fully completed by Friday.
請確保報告在週五前完全完成。

items.pos: n. 遊戲；競賽 | adj. 願意冒險的
items.colloc: business game 商業賽局 | play the game 遵守規則
items.distinct: match 比賽 | sport 運動
ex: The team is playing a challenging game of strategy.
團隊正在進行一場具挑戰性的策略賽局。
He is always game for a new business venture.
他總是願意嘗試新的商業冒險。
Success in the market is like a complex game.
市場競爭就像一場複雜的遊戲。

items.colloc: social gathering 社交聚會 | attend a gathering 參加聚會
items.distinct: meeting 會議 | assembly 集會
ex: The annual gathering brings all regional managers together.
年度聚會將所有區域經理聚集在一起。
We are planning a small gathering for the retirement.
我們正在為退休人員籌備一個小型聚會。
Informal gatherings help build a better team culture.
非正式聚會有助於建立更好的團隊文化。

items.pos: adj. 空心的；虛偽的 | n. 洞；凹處
items.colloc: hollow promise 空頭支票 | hollow structure 空心結構
items.distinct: empty 空的 | vacant 空缺的
ex: He made a hollow promise to fix the issue quickly.
他開出空頭支票說會快速解決問題。
The metal pipe has a hollow core for wiring.
這根金屬管中心是空的，用於配線。
Without action, these marketing slogans remain hollow.
若無實際行動，這些行銷口號就顯得虛偽。
